Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

Face: broad oval face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: one offset razor line. Visible personal details: a shaped cloth clasp; one asymmetric ear cuff; a wrapped keepsake cord. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: deliberately tousled but clean. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a folded handkerchief only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
